03 · Themes

Three ideas that run through every room

I

Alpine lodge, modernized

Wood walls, a real fire, velvet and leather, mountains on the wall. Ski-lodge warmth with clean, sleek lines.

II

Glow after dark

Many low, warm lights instead of one bright ceiling: shelf LEDs, picture lights, pendants, lamps and candles, all 2700K and dimmable.

III

Collected, not cluttered

Closed cabinets hide the everyday. Open shelves get only the edit: books, one object, a plant. One strong moment per passion.

04 · Scenes

Moments around the house

The fireside

A chunky wood mantel, black firebox, stacked logs as decor.

The collectibles shelf

Star Wars pieces on the top row, lit and spaced like a gallery.

The lit gallery wall

Your ski and dive photos under brass picture lights.

Toller’s spot

His copper coat is literally part of the palette.

Kitchen glow

Brass domes over marble; under-cabinet light after sunset.

Mountains on the wall

An art-mode TV that reads as a painting when it’s off.

05 · Your story

Where your passions live

Skiing

Goggles on the shelf, ski prints framed, gear in a closed entry bench.

Scuba diving

Your own dive photos, printed big, as Deep Sea accents.

Outdoors

Mountain art, a real fire, knit throws, forest views.

Travel

A globe, a stack of travel books, frames you rotate after trips.

Star Wars

One lit collectibles row in the office; one framed poster downstairs.

Gardening

Trailing pothos on shelves, olive branches, herbs by the stove.

Toller

Durable patterned rugs, a bed in every hangout room, a muddy-paw drop zone.

Organized

Closed cabinets under every built-in; one in, one out on display.
